items.example: I'm sorry I'm late for the meeting.
There was a long queue at the coffee shop.
I woke up late and missed my train.
My car broke down on the motorway.
I lost my keys and couldn't get into the flat.
I didn't hear my alarm clock because I had ear plugs in.
I slept with ear plugs and didn't hear the alarm.
I'm so sorry I missed the meeting. I feel awful about it.
I was embarrassed because I was so late.
My train hit a cow. Poor thing.

items.term: stop in the middle of nowhere
items.example: The train stopped in the middle of nowhere for twenty minutes.
The manager wasn't happy about my excuse.
You're twenty minutes late. — Don't worry about it.
The manager said: Don't let it happen again.
